description_en: Creates pay-as-you-go or subscription cloud phone instance groups. An instance group can manage multiple instances. You can organize instances with the same functional purpose into the same instance group for unified management
description_zh: 创建按量付费或包年包月的云手机实例组。一个实例组可以管理多个实例。可以将具有相同功能定位的实例编入同一个实例组，以便于统一管理
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic create-android-instance-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-group-name Cloud_phoneA --number-of-instances 1 --charge-type PostPaid --period 1 --period-unit Month --instance-group-spec acp.basic.small --auto-pay false --auto-renew false --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7459760000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf61uvzhz8ejaw7760000 --policy-group-id pg-b7bxrrwxkijjh0000 --image-id imgc-06zyt9m93zwax0000 --amount 8 --gpu-acceleration false --key-pair-id kp-7o9xywwfutc1l0000 --client-token asadbuvwiabdbvchj0000 --enable-ipv6 false --ipv6-bandwidth 1 --tag Value=value Key=key --network-info BandwidthPackageName=example-string PromotionId=example-string Isp=example-string AutoRenew=true CidrBlock=example-string Period=1 PaidCallbackUrl=example-string PayType=example-string AutoPay=true InternetChargeType=example-string IpRatio=1 LimitedBandwidth=1 VisibleType=example-string PeriodUnit=example-string --bandwidth-package-type example-string --bandwidth-package-id example-string --network-type example-string --promotion-id example-string --stream-mode 1 --paid-call-back-url wya.wuying.aliyun.com/instanceGroup --sale-mode example-string --instance-version example-string --channel-cookie example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAndroidInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions where cloud phone instances can be purchased
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)查询云手机支持购买的地域列表
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance group name.

The instance group name cannot exceed 30 characters in length. It must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
实例组名称。

实例组名称长度不超过30个字符；请以大/小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，仅支持中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The number of instances in the instance group. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 实例组中的实例数量。最大值为100
parameters.name: number_of_instances

parameters.help_en: The billing type
parameters.help_zh: 计费类型
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The instance group specification. You can call [DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~) to query the specifications available for cloud phone instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例组规格。可以通过调用[DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~)查询云手机支持购买的规格
parameters.name: instance_group_spec

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动付费。默认为false
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动续费。默认为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

To create a shared network instance: the network ID is optional. Specify the network ID of the Shared Network type on the Cloud Phone console > Network (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no shared network exists in the console, you can leave this parameter empty. A shared network is automatically created when the instance group is created.

To create a VPC network instance: the network ID is required. Specify the network ID of the VPC Network type on the Cloud Phone console > Network (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no VPC network exists in the console, create a network first
parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

创建共享网络实例：网络ID选填。填写云手机控制台>网络 (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为共享网络的网络ID。如果控制台没有共享网络，可以不用填写，将会在创建实例组时自动创建一个共享网络。

创建VPC网络实例：网络ID必填。填写云手机控制台>网络 (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为VPC网络的网络ID，如果控制台没有VPC网络，则需要先创建网络
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448774.html to query the list of vSwitches.

To create a shared network instance: leave this parameter empty.

To create a VPC network instance: the vSwitch ID is required. The specified vSwitch is used to create the instance
parameters.help_zh:
交换机 ID。可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448774.html查询交换机列表。

创建共享网络实例：不填写。

创建VPC网络实例：交换机 ID 必填。选用此交换机来创建实例
